test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

No sooner did / the child start crying / then the mother / hugged him.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'then the mother'.*****__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. 
 
• Here,** 'than the mother' **should be used instead of** 'then the mother​'. **
 
• We know that 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'. 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *No sooner had I started mowing the lawn **than **it started raining. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] *
 
• *No sooner had I started mowing the lawn **then **it started raining. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. 

 

Correct Sentence:__ No sooner did the child start crying** __than the mother__** hugged him.*
